notes.title: NeverLight Devlog #2: Shaping the Darkness
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45444591/05d707d9dfeec9cf2cedb465034867956a04689c.jpg[/img]

Hey there, fellow Hunters!

We've been hard at work on NeverLight these past months, and we're excited to share our progress with you. Let's dive into what's new...

---

[h1][b]WHAT'S NEW[/b][/h1]

[h2]Fresh Trailer & Updated Steam Page[/h2]

We just dropped a new teaser trailer! We've also completely refreshed our Steam page with new screenshots and a better description of what NeverLight is all about.

[previewyoutube=yxkbat8m4R0;full][/previewyoutube]

Like what you see? [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3444260/NeverLight/]Check out our updated Steam page![/url]

[h2]Visual Overhaul[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45444591/f1377fd5516bce34a0e1a74a9d23fdec5771ca16.jpg[/img]

Thanks to your feedback, we've completely redesigned the game's visuals. The world of NeverLight has transformed, and we think you're going to love it.

[h2]New Area: The Crimson Chasms[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45444591/e2664d305f68b922ac3b145fc0215c619e36ed35.jpg[/img]

We've created a new area for you to explore - The Crimson Chasms. These molten caverns are home to one of our favorite new monsters: the Magma Weavers. These massive spider-like creatures use burning silk to trap unwary hunters.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45444591/d787a37410fa91fcb75636b23807046e4f807ff0.jpg[/img]

The rewards here are worth the risk... if you make it out alive!

[h2]Stealth Mechanics Coming Soon[/h2]

Not everyone wants to fight head-on. Our upcoming stealth system will let you:

* Put out lights to create shadow paths
* Track monsters safely from a distance
* Use the environment as cover
* Deliver powerful surprise attacks

We'll show you more of this system in the next two weeks!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45444591/0170edf48f623bcfa4421477096d91e34aebc067.jpg[/img]

[h2]Beta Coming This Summer[/h2]

We're working on:
* A test map showing off the core gameplay
* A tutorial to help you learn the basics
* Extraction mechanics that make every decision matter
* Few playable classes with unique abilities
* Hardcore monsters to fight with

The beta will begin in late summer or early autumn. We'll share registration details in our next update!

[h2]Meet Us at Nordic Game 2025![/h2]

We're thrilled to announce that NeverLight will be showcased at Nordic Game 2025 this May - one of Europe's most popular gaming conventions for B2B!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45444591/4193a9d1bb669c98c5ea68c752849df08d4ceb72.png[/img]

If you're planning to attend, come find our booth to:

[list]
[*] Play an exclusive demo
[*] Meet our dev team in person
[*] Get some limited NeverLight merch
[/list]
This will be our first public showing!

---

[h1][b]COMMUNITY CORNER[/b][/h1]

[h2]Coming Soon[/h2]

In the next few weeks, we'll be:
* Showing extended gameplay footage
* Hosting dev streams where we can chat directly
* Gathering your feedback on what we've built so far

[h2]1,000+ Wishlists - Thank You![/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45444591/c8a207306b35f1f2bf8dd75a6cfcf1e1a5148abc.jpg[/img]

We've hit over 1,000 wishlists! This means so much to our small team. If you haven't added NeverLight yet:

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3444260/NeverLight/]→ ADD TO YOUR WISHLIST ←[/url]

[h2]Reddit Success[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45444591/22ddae6aae17f4d7cef2a3e2484a166230313f74.jpg[/img]

Our Reddit posts reached over 1,000 likes in just two weeks! We're blown away by your support. 

Want to join the conversation? Visit our [url=https://www.reddit.com/r/NeverLight/]subreddit[/url]!

[h2]Discord Updates[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45444591/e4fc411a6e86cc9a205936aabff88638f8105c6c.jpg[/img]

We've redesigned our Discord server with:
* Themed channels that match the game world
* Better organization
* Spaces for both newcomers and veterans

[url=https://discord.gg/NPcDaPFteE]→ JOIN OUR DISCORD ←[/url]

[h2]Help Create the Game[/h2]

We want your ideas! Join our Discord to submit:
* Creature concepts
* Scenario ideas

If we choose your submission, you'll get:
* A special Discord role
* Your name in the credits
* Your creation in the game!

[h2]Follow Us Everywhere[/h2]

We're now on:
* [url=https://www.reddit.com/r/NeverLight/]Reddit[/url]
* [url=https://bsky.app/profile/neverlightgame.bsky.social]BlueSky[/url]
* [url=https://www.instagram.com/neverlightgame/]Instagram[/url]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45444591/a61e5985ee1fe3c252d6d92d70b5c9bd60563e4d.jpg[/img]

Thanks for following our journey! In NeverLight, survival is never guaranteed. Will you find treasure in the darkness, or become part of it?

See you in the shadows,

[i]- The Nightless Games Team[/i]
